import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    """Return the k most common words in text.

    Words are maximal runs of ASCII letters and apostrophes, compared
    case-insensitively. Results are sorted by count descending, then
    alphabetically, as a list of (word, count) tuples.
    """
    if k <= 0:
        return []
    counts = Counter(match.lower() for match in _WORD_RE.findall(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
